title: The post-commit hook regenerates the registry by default and reindexes knowledge search only when a clone opts in
summary: The reindex in the post-commit hook is opt-in via git config knowledge.reindexOnCommit; registry regen stays unconditional.

title: The knowledge-index build tests get the address space they need: the resource budget lowers only the soft limit, and the build tests are marked large
summary: Measured the build (not memory-bound); the pytest RLIMIT_AS cap refused it. Soft-limit-only conftest, large marker on the build tests, regression test.

title: The ride-along rule is written into CLAUDE.md and the delivery guide's PR Lifecycle
summary: Owner's ride-along rule is now in CLAUDE.md and delivery_process.md, text applied verbatim.
